content.text:
Findings — pricing-page diff: [LOW] pricing-section.module.css:88-90 — `.brDesktopOnly { display: inline; }` is misleadingly named: it shows the `
` at every viewport. Mobile fallback to a space never triggers, so the line break renders on phones too. Fix: add `@media (max-width: 767px) { .brDesktopOnly { display: none; } }` (or rename if intentional). [LOW] pricing-section.tsx:62-66 — `
` inside h1 with surrounding `{" "}` is read aloud by most screen readers as a pause without losing the sentence — semantically fine, but consider `` with a CSS pseudo line-break for cleaner SR output. Not blocking. [INFO] pricing-section.tsx:87 + module.css:707,726 — The base-rule `.pricingTabLinkMonthly` was deleted, but the class is still applied in JSX **and** still has two responsive overrides at 479px (lines 707-713, 726-728). The class is not dead — the @479 styles still match. Harmless: button keeps its base from `.pricingTabLink` and gets the mobile column-flex tweak. Either intentional or worth a comment in CSS noting "base intentionally inherited from .pricingTabLink". [INFO] pricing.ts:229-239 — `PRICING_PLANS.reduce(...)` runs once at module-eval. Page is static-rendered (`/pricing` SSG per build log), so this executes at build time, baked into the bundle. Zero runtime cost. Fine. [INFO] roi-calculator.tsx — Single-source-of-truth: confirmed no remaining duplication. `BillingPeriod` union now matches across both files. `PlanKey`/`PresetKey` discriminate `Object.keys(...) as PlanKey[]` casts safely (keys are statically typed records). [INFO] pricing-section.tsx — `ctaLabel: Record` exhaustive on union, no narrowing gaps. Homepage path (`asH1=false`) renders `

` and skips `.newPriceSecPage` scoping — h1 50px override only applies on /pricing. No regression risk. No hooks-conditional issues, no `any`, no `@ts-ignore`. tsc/lint/build all green. **Ship it.** Address the `.brDesktopOnly` mobile fallback in next polish pass.
